data.title: Silicon Valley Households Face Rising Costs with Little to Fall Back On, Second Harvest Survey Finds

data.title: SOCRadar Launches New API Suite That Lets MSSPs Build or White-Label Threat Intelligence
data.description: In Newark, Delaware, SOCRadar, a prominent figure in extended threat intelligence and cybersecurity, has introduced a new dual-layered API suite tailored for MSSPs. This innovative suite empowers MSSPs to either develop their own threat intelligence capabilities or utilize white labeling options. MSSPs can now opt for either complete multi-tenant, backend platform automation or direct ingestion of raw threat intelligence to create unique features. This customizable approach allows partners to interact with SOCRadar's technology in a manner that aligns with their specific needs.
